tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sam+bu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub

thabs yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal sam+bu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bde stong dbyer med sgyu ma'i rnam rol las// e waṃ phyag rgya'i rol rtsed kyi zlos gar// gzugs sku'i bkod pa chu zla'i snang brnyan can// dgyes pa rdo rje gdod ma'i lha der 'dud// gdod ma'i dgyes rdor lam du ngos bzung nas// 'bras bu de nyid mngon du rtogs pa'i phyir// mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i phreng ba 'di// ma rnying gsar du spel la spro ba 'phel/ /'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis sgrub par 'dod pas/ sngon du bya ba'i rim pa ni/ gnas dur khrod dam/ gur las/ nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang*// nags tshal skye bo'i dur khrod du| |bsnyen sgrub bgyis la dngos grub ster// zhes pa'i don/ nags tshal chen po'i dbus sam/ shing gcig drung la sogs pa'i yid dang mthun zhing mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sha za du ma rgyu ba'i sar/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mdun du/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ mchod pa'i gtor ma rnams bshams/ rang gi mdun du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung rnams dung chos su bshams pa'i mdun du bzed zhal gsum dang*/ 'thor 'thung la ku sha'i chun pos brgyan pa dang*/ gos zung rnams bshams/ rang gi g.yas su rdo rje/ dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ bdud rtsi ril bus sbags pa'i bsang chu'i snod ku sha dang bcas pa dang*/ nye logs su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma yang nyer bsdogs byas la gnas khang dar zab 'phan gdugs kyis mdzes par byas te| rang nyid stan bde bar bris sku la kha phyogs te dang ba'i yid kyis 'dug go// sgrub thabs dngos la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba'i chos la'ang gsum ste/

bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ tshogs bsag pa/ srung 'khor bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs nas nang mchod la bsang chu 'thor ro// dril bu pas/ sems can rdzus te skyes pa bzhin// sa bon med par rnam par bsam// zhes pa ltar/ 'dir skad cig gi sgras sa bon tsam yang med par krong gis bskyed par ni/ rdzus skyes sbyong ba la dgongs so// oṃ āḥham̐'u badz+ra ghasma rī oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa swā hā sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bdud rtsi lnga la hūm̐ bh+rūṃ aṃ hrīḥkhaṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ sha lnga la khaṃ buṃ hūm̐ hrīḥtrāṃ gis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ha hoḥhrīḥser dkar sngo ba'i mdog can gyi 'od can gyi tha mal pa'i kha dog dri ro nus pa sbyangs te yi ge rnams rdzas la thim/ rang gi sna bug gi rlung gis bskyod pas bdud rtsi'i 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas zhu zhing khol bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ka ka kaḍ+ḍh+ya na ba ba ban+dha na kha kha khā da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭā ni ha na ha na ga ga ghā ta ya a mu ka s+ya shān+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ ha zhes bya bas kha dog 'phrog /hoḥzhes bya bas gzhom par byas// hrīḥzhes bya bas nus pa 'joms// mdog mdzes pad+ma'i dbang phyug ste// dri zhim pa ni rnam snang mdzad// ro ni rdo rje dbang phyug ste// sa gsum gyi ni bdag gir gyur//

ces brjod/ byin rlabs 'di sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa dgu rab tu byed pa gnyis nas so// sngon 'gro'i gtor ma la chu dang nang mchod bran la/ bdud rtsi ltar byin rlabs te rdo rje'i thal mo kha phye bas/ brtag gnyis las/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa la// sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir// rdo rje sems dpa'i gtor ma bsten// zhes pa'i don no// oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka /ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sam+bu+u ṭa'i brtag pa brgyad pa las yang dag pa 'byung bas de nas bshad pa'i sngags gsum brjod la dril bu gsil zhing*/ zo zo za bar gyis shig gnod sbyin dang*// srin po dang ni yi dwags 'byung po dang*// sha za grul bum rjed byed mkha' 'gro dang*// mkha' 'gro la sogs kun la gtor ma 'di// bzung bar mdzod cig dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod// dngos grub thams cad bdag la bstsal du gsol// ji ltar bza' ba'i rnam pa 'di dang 'di// gzhib dang btung ba'i rnam pa 'di ji ltar// rim par ji bzhin bde chen bya ba kun// rnam dag rig dang lhan cig bdag mdzad gsol// zhes brjod la gtor ma 'bul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin du gyur| oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shapad= sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs la/ gnyis pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par

dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ yang*/ badz+ra gau rī pū dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ gau rā ི 'i gnas su/ tsau rī/ be tā lī/ ghasma rī/ puk+ka sī/ sha wa rī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ waṃ she/ wī ṇi/ mu kuṇ+ḍa/ mṛ taṃ ge/ zhes lha mo bcu gnyis dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi sogs/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza hūm̐ hūm̐ gis nang mchod thigs gtor dang*/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka yo gi nī a nu rā ga yā mi/ shī shī shī/ zhes 'khyud pa'i rgyas gsang mchod phul nas/ gur las/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin mchod cing*// bdun po yongs su dag par bya// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// zhes pa'i don no// bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung dang*// ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyogs pa rnams// thugs rje che ldan de dag spyan sngar ni// cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag kun la yang dag yi rangs shing*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras sgrub// snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs// rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi// bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*// sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// 'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur zhing*// snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan// rab tu dga' sogs sa la gnas pa yi// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// bsam dang rnam par dag pa las gyur pa'i// sgrib pa kun la bag chags yang dag 'byin// lhag par mos pa'i rnam par brgyan pa yi// sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu// sbyin sogs rnam dag dkar po'i yon tan tshul// rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bos blos| |yang dag nyid du bdag nyid gnas par bgyi'o//

zhes gsum brjod la/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ brtag gnyis las/ dang po byams pa bsgom par bya// gnyis pa snying rje rnam bsgoms shing*// gsum pa dga' ba bsgom par bya// kun gyi mtha' ni btang snyoms so// zhes pa'i don no// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dbang gis 'di nas gtso bo bskyed pa yan bsnyen pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du zhu ba rang la thim zhing*/ rang gi lus kyang stod smad nas zhu ba thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs par gyur/ brtag gnyis las/ yang ni stong pa'i byang chub ste// zhes dang*/ gur du/ bden rdzun rnam par dpyad pa yis// rtog pas nye bar ma gos te// ma skyes pa yi sbyor ba yis// skye ba 'dir ni rab tu brjod// ces pa'i don ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad sems tsam las med pa dang*/ sbyong byed kyi rten dang brten pa thams cad kyang ye shes las gzhan du med par thag bcad de rdzogs rim du bsdus nas/ nam mkhar nā da tsam zhig 'jog par bshad pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad mi dmigs par btang nas ye shes tsam zhig la mnyam par 'jog dgos pa'i shes byed du bstan nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs par bshad pas na ye shes nyid la'ang chags zhen spang dgos par bstan to// slar yang*/ nam mkha'i khams su gzhi lam kun la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nā da shin tu phra ba 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba gyen du bsgrengs pa'i ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur ces/ slar nā da de langs par bshad pas rnal 'byor pa'i bskyed rim 'bras bu'i he ru ka sgrub par byed pa'i shes rgyud ngos bzung ba'o// 'og tu 'chad pa'i rgyu'i sa bon rnam par shes pa gzhi dus kyi ye shes sa bon dang phyag mtshan tu gyur pa dang*/

nam mkha'i nā da gnyis mthar thug dbyer med kyang*/ gnas skabs su sa bon dang phyag mtshan gzhi dus kyi ye shes de ni de ltar 'jug pa sogs byed pa'i rgyu dus dang de dus kyi kun slong gi bdag gir byed pa'i rnam shes yin la/ nam mkha'i nā da ni gzhi lam kun la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin pas skabs 'dir so sor dbye la/ mthar thug rnam shes dang ye shes rjes mthun pas 'bras bu he ru ka'i dus ni dbyer med pa'i phyir rnam shes de lam gyi dngos gzhir bzhag pa ma yin no// yang rnal 'byor pa rang gi chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ngo bo nam mkhar gnas pa de ni nā da'i sgra'i rang bzhin can zhes bya la/ de dang ngo bo gcig kyang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i tshul can rang gi gzhi dus kyi ye shes hūm̐ aṃ rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa nyi zla'i bar du bcug ste mngon byang lngas rgyu he ru ka yab yum du bskyed nas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis shes rgyud rdzas tha dad pa lta bur re zhig bzhag ste/ rgyu he ru ka yab yum de pha ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par bkug pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon yum gyi mngal du bab pas/ sems can gzhan mang po rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod nas zhing gzhan du bzhugs par gsol pa spun zla lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzhi lam kun la khyab byed du 'jug pa ye shes kyi bdag nyid nam mkha'i nā da de yab gyi zhal du zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu ba thig le'i gzugs kyi gnas pa la/ lha mo bzhi phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yab yum gyis bskul nas/ 'bras bu he ru ka rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa ni gdung rigs mi gcod pa rgyal bu gzhon nu ltar 'khrungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/

'di yang ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ lus dkyil bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi khyad par can grub nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha tshogs spro ba dang*/ de yang bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas mthar phyin par bya ba gsungs pa rnams 'di'i skabs su mngon byang gi zab khyad phul du phyin shos yin pa/ grub chen nag po spyod pa dang*/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje sogs 'phags yul gyi grub chen mang po nas brgyud/ bod kyi bla ma gong ma'i slob bshad kyi man ngag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa sgrub brgyud dam pa'i khyad chos gang zag rjes 'jug las dang po pa rnams kyi mngal skyes sbyong byed khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ kha cig mi shes kyang shes par rlom pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas thams cad kyis shes bzhin khyad du gsod pa'i gnas ni 'di ma yin no// zhes mngon byang lnga dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis dang*/ gzhi'i rnam shes dang chos dbyings ye shes sogs dang*/ mngal 'byin sogs kyi bskyed rim gyi skabs kyi the tshom gyi 'phrang 'gag mtha' dag las sgrol ba'i mtha' dpyod phyogs gcig tu 'dir bris pa yin pas/ stod smad mtha' dag tu skabs su gang babs der legs par rtogs par gyis shig /gsum pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos 'di dag sems can nyid kyis bzhag pa ste/ sems ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i phyir rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'o// oṃ tsit+taṃ pra ti be dhaṃ ka ro mi/ sdig pa dag pa'i dkyil 'khor che// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// gnas ngan len gyi gnas las grol// rtog pa kun las nges par grol// zhes dang*/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ tsit+ta pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis gsang sngags kyi lam du sems bskyed nas/ brtag gnyis las| de bas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas// nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste// rdo rje de nyid kyi ni ra ba dang*// gur bcing ba yang rnam par bsgom par bya'o// zhes pa'i don/

stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs la dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ de'i logs su rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ steng du rdo rje'i mda' yi dra ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re dang*/ phyi rol thams cad rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad dang steng 'og gnyis te rtsibs bcu pa sbubs su grub pa g.yas skor du 'gro ba mi mngon par mgyogs par 'khor ba'i rtsibs rnams su pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

gur las/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzi brjid che// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba ste// 'khor zhing rab tu mi g.yo ba// zhes dang*/ hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis// khro bo bcu ni rab tu 'bod// ces pa'i don no// las shar du gshin rje mthar byed sngon po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ byang du bgegs mthar byed don grub kyi cod pan can/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po= lho nub tu dbyug pa sngon po= nub byang du stobs po che= byang shar du mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ thams cad kyang g.yas pa'i shar nas 'og gi bar rim bzhin/ dbyug tho/ dbyug pa/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing rnams 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams sbrul zhags dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs can phyogs dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang*/ mtshams kyi khro bo bzhi dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams brlag par byed par gyur/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā ṇāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ gha nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma le/ oṃ shaṅka re/ auṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yan+t+ra/ man+t+ra/ mū la karma bhan+dhā naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la naṃ wā/ ma ma kri te/ ye na ke na tsi ta/ kṛ tan+ta ta/ sarban+tu/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas sbyor ba'i cho ga'o// dngos gzhi la bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gsum/ yan lag gi lha bskyed pa dang*/ lha sgom pa nas dag dran dang*/ sngags bzla ba'o| |dang po yan lag drug gi sbyor ba ste/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag /rjes su chags pa rdor sems kyi yan lag /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag gi yan lag /mchod pa don grub kyi yan lag |bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag rnams las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ rnal 'byor bzhi 'di nas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar rnal 'byor bar e las chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum 'og tu phra zhing steng du yangs pa'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum gyi lte bar laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ brtag gnyis las/ nam mkha'i dbus su bha ga bsam// dbus su rnam par bsgom pa ni// 'khor lo sngon du ci rigs pa// lha rnams ji ltar 'byung ba nyid// 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon// ji ltar rigs par byin za dang*// lha rnams kyi ni byin chen dang*// ji ltar bsgoms pa sogs 'byung ba'ang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum rdo rje'i lte bar raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gnyis la yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rnam par snang mdzad kyi bum las gyur pa'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang brtag gnyis las/ ston pas dkyil 'khor 'di skad gsungs// gru bzhi yang dag ldan pa nyid// sgo bzhi gzi brjid chen po ste// do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan// phreng ba la sogs mda' yab ldan// ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan// zhes pa'i don/

ting 'dzin gsum gyi 'di nas mngal 'byin gyi bar dang po'i sbyor ba'o// gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i nang nas nag /dmar/ ljang*/ ser/ dkar pa'i rtsig pa lnga'i steng du pha gu ser po la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa'i steng du/ gser gyi ska rags bzhi la btags pa'i chu srin dmar skya'i kha nas mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du ba ku la sngon po la ril ba dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa lta bus bteg pa'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la gnas pa'i rin po che'i bum pa las thon pa'i dbyug pa la zla tshes rdo rje rin po ches mtshan pa'i dar gyi cod pan gyi rtse mor dril bu dang*/ g.yer kha dang*| zla ba rlung gis bskyod pas spras shing*/ gzhan yang srog chags kyi rigs kyis mtshan pa'i rgyan chen po brgyad dang*/ zur bzhir gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod snam dmar po'i steng du lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo bzhi sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang rtsig pa'i zur gyi phyi nang du zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ de thams cad kyi nam mkhar sprin gyi gseb nas lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos khrus kyi chu dang me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams rgyu ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum pos mdzes par phub pa'i thog phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo'i steng du bum pa las thon pa'i rin po che'i ka ba phyogs kyi mdog can bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs| gser dang*/ shar bu/ rin po che/ rmig pa/ mun pa/ wa raṇ+ḍa/ mun pa/ shar bu/ rin po che/

rmig pa/ mda' yab ste snam bu bcu gcig gi steng du pad zla'i gdan la chos kyi 'khor lo ser po dang*/ gdugs dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo la sogs pas mdzes pa/ rta babs bcu gcig rang rang gi mdog dang mtshan mas spras shing gu ṇa ha ri'i dra phyed dang bcas pas spras pa/ khang bzang thams cad kyi steng 'og thams cad/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba/ de'i phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba'i phyi rol du/ shar du gtum drag /lhor keng rus can/ nub tu rdo rje 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du mi bzad bzhad pa/ shar lhor bkra shis tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa drag po/ nub byang du ki li ki la sgrog pa/ sdom 'byung las/ gtum drag de bzhin tshang tshing dang*// rdo rje 'bar ba keng rus can// dbang ldan du ni mi bzad bzhad// byin za du ni bkra shis tshal// mun pa drag po bden bral du// rlung phyogs ki li ki li'i sgra// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de rnams kyi mtshams su chu brgyad kyis phye ba/ de dag rer shing brgyad kyi rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon gnyis pas thod pa thogs nas yum la 'khyud pa/ shing gi rtse mor zhing skyong brgyad/ g.yas gtor ma dang g.yon thod pa bzung nas shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed thon pa/ chu brgyad la klu chen po brgyad gnas pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar sprin chen po brgyad rang rang gi phyogs skyong gi mdog can glog phreng 'khrugs shing 'brug gi sgra sgrog pa/ gzhan yang dur khrod de rnams su rin po che'i lhun po la sogs pa ri chen po brgyad kyi steng du/

rdo rje dkar po la sogs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ ye shes kyi me dang*/ thugs rje'i chu dang*/ grub chen dang*/ phra men ma brgyad brgyad dang*/ khwa ta dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ dur bya dang*/ ce spyang pho mo dang*/ 'ol ba dang*/ seng ge dang*/ stag gi gdong can/ sbrul ba lang gi mgo can dang*/ gdong gnyis pa sogs phyogs rnams su rgyug cing*/ ro dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ro mdung gis phug pa dang*/ ro gsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/ ma tshig pa dang*/ mgo thod dang*/ byin pa dang*/ lag pa dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ lto ba dang*/ nang khrol 'thor ba dang*/ mgo zlum brtsegs dang*/ rus pa'i tshogs kyis gang ba dang*/ rig 'dzin dang grub thob dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ ro langs dang*/ srin po dang*/ 'byung po ma rungs pa'i tshogs thams cad tshogs shing rgyu la gar byed pa/ ki li ki la sgrog pa/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje nag po'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan g.yas skor du 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha snam sngon po gru bzhi pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyi'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i phyogs bzhi dmar zhing*/ me rlung ser po/ dbang ldan sngon po/ lte ba dang bden bral ljang gu/ ze'u 'bru ser po'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ phung po'i bdud tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa/ lag gnyis g.yas phreng ba dang ril ba/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang dbyug pa thogs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag po gdong bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang be con/ g.yon gnyis mdung dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug dkar po gdong gcig pa/ g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ lha'i bu'i bdud dbang po ser po gdong gcig pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams gan rkyal du mgo g.yas su phyogs pa'i steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i thog tu thod pa khrag gis bkang ba'i steng du zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/

phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du thod pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa re re/ lha snam gyi gru bzhir pad+ma'i steng du thod khrag de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i khyams dang sgo'i nang du pad+ma'i steng du thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ de'i steng du dbugs bral gyi gdan gan rkyal du 'gyel ba mgo nang du phyogs pa re re bcas pa gsal bar gyur pa dmigs so// zhes brjod/ da ni lha bskyed pa la yang bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yi dbang gi 'di nas spyi bor oṃ yan nye bar sgrub pa/ mchan/ mngal skyes sbyong ba mngon byang lnga bskyed zhu ba glus bskul bcas pa dang*/ sgong skyes sbyong ba mngon byang lnga la glus bskul med pa dang*/ rdzus skyes sbyong ba skad cig dkrong bskyed du sgom pa gsum las/ 'dir mngal skyes sbyong ba gtso bor byas te bskyed pa ni/ nges brjod bla ma las/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis// bsgoms pa rnams kyang yongs su brtag /ces gsungs pa yin no// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a na la ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo*// gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdor sems kyi yan lag ni/ snang bcas ye shes kyi tshogs mnyam bzhag las ma lang ba'i ngang nas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ brtag gnyis las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan// bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan// rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni// so sor rtog pa brjod par bya// thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid// rdzogs pa'i chos dbyings dag pa ste| |mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yi// rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid// ces pa'i don/ a ā/ i ī/ nas/ aḥ g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ka kha ga gha nga*/ nas/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/

de gnyis kyi bar du rang gi gzhi dus kyi ye shes rgyu'i hūm̐ dang aṃ sngon po 'bar zhing 'dzag pa las/ rdo rje mthing nag gi lte ba la hūm̐ dang*/ gri gug sngon po'i lte bar aṃ gis mtshan pa skad cig gis gsal zhing nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ rim gyis brtsegs pa'i rnam par gsal ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ de dag kyang oṃ nas rim gyis bsdus te nā da yang 'khyog pa'i rnam par bor nas skra tsam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshul dang zhes bya ba'i ming gi nyi zla'i bar gyi sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim pa gsum po ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ zla nyi phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta s+thi ta a haṃ| dbus kyi bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid skad cig gis rgyu'i he ru ka rnal 'byor bzhi yi de nas 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar/ dgyes pa rdo rje zhabs bzhi sa la brdabs pas lha dang lha yin dam la btags shing khros pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag cing drag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar la zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ rgyab zhal bzhi shin tu gnag cing gtum pa/ steng zhal dud kha mi sdug pa thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa 'bar zhing kyog po'i smin ma khro gnyer dang ldan pa'i spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum la/ gdangs mig phyogs bcur lta zhing 'khrugs pa/ skra ser po gyen du phyogs pa'i phyed bcings shing phyed brdzes pa'i skra mtshams su thod skam lnga lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can rdo rje'i phreng bas sbrel ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa/

tshangs skud se ral khar sgrog pa phrag gong g.yon du thogs pa/ rus chen gyi rgyan/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub skor/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ rgod pa/ drag shul/ 'jigs pa'i snying rje/ rngam zhing zhi ba'i nyams te gar dgur ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gnyis pas pad+ma bzung ba dang lhan cig glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa'i lag g.yon dang rkang g.yon nas bzung ste rgyab tu gyon pa'i mgo bo g.yas su phyogs pa/ g.yas gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ drug pa na rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ bdun pa na tri shūl/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu thogs pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lnga pa na thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ drug pa na rin po che/ bdun pa na sdigs mdzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs rgyab ma gnyis g.yas brkyang bas bdud bzhi'i mgo bo mnan zhing g.yon bskum pa'i zhabs kyis bdud bzhi'i rkang pa brdzis pa/ mdun ma gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung phyed pa'i thabs kyis thod khrag zla ba dang bcas pa'i steng du bzhengs pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thogs pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i spyan gsum mnga' zhing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'i khrod du skra mtshams su thod pa skam po lngas spras shing skam po lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ gcer bu mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas yab kyi rked la 'khril zhing g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan tu brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ yab yum shin tu bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'i 'od zer dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma

snang stong zung 'jug gi de nyid sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi mtshon tshul ni/ bden par ma grub kyang snang cha tsam du yan lag nying lag sogs snang ba sgyu ma'i mi lta bu/ gcig gis thams cad la khyab pa nam mkha'i zla ba chu nang thams cad la 'char ba lta bu/ sha rus la sogs pa gdos bcas su ma grub pas mig yor te grib ma lta bu/ skad cig gis g.yo ba smig rgyu lta bu/ sems tsam las ma grub pa rmi lam gyi lus lta bu/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa brag cha lta bu/ snang yang dngos po med pa dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ gcig du mar snang nus pa sprin nam mig 'phrul lta bu/ kha dog gsal zhing thogs pa med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ mi rtag cing myur ba glog lta bu/ skad cig gis ldang ba chu bur lta bu/ snang yang rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ rnams su bhai+eṃ dgos/ de bzhin du 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyang snang stong zung 'jug gi sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon par bsgom mo// lta bu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi 'di nas ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yum gyi dpral bar oṃ dang*/ snying khar hūm̐/ gsang gnas kyi nam mkha' mi dmigs pa hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi gsang ba rdo rje mi dmigs pa ste hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rtse mor nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag par gyur/ de nas yab kyis yum la/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra/ ma hā rā ga su khan+da da/ tsa tur ā nan+da bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kārayaṃ ku ru ṣ+yā mi/ zhes pas bskul zhing*/ yum gyis yab la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa/ kha tsa tu rānan+da ya kaḥ kha ga mu kha e/ kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kārayaṃ ku ru ṣ+yā mi/ zhes bskul ba'i sgras yab yum bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas thabs shes gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po'i sgra shī shī shī zhes pa'i mthus/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bkug pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon/ thig le dum bu bcu drug tu gyur pa yum gyi pad+mar bab pas zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur/ ces dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ de nas yum gyi pad+ma'i thig le gur las/ dang po skyes bu bsam de nas// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo spro// zhes pa'i don/ bcu drug po phyir spros pas phyogs mtshams kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi gdan dang*/ lha rnams kyi zur gyi gdan rnams dang*/ sgo bzhi'i gdan rnams kyi steng zla nyi kha sbyor re re'i bar du sa bon so so bar gyur pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ/ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad dang*/ slar yang mda' dang*/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ sbrul/ seng ge/ dge slong*/ stag /ce spyang*/ thod pa rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa zla nyi dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas gnyis na mda' dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug /g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang ro hi ta'i nya dang bcas pa'i thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu dang phag pa dang bcas pa'i thod khrag /nub tu be tā lī ser mo g.yas gnyis na ral gri rus sbal gyis mtshan pa'i thod khrag /g.yon gnyis na chang dang dri chus gang ba'i thod pa gnyis/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas gnyis na sbrul dang bcas pa'i rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab dang dgra sta/ dbang ldan tu puk+ka sī ser po g.yas gnyis na shas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i seng ge dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis na dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dang rin po che|

mer sha wa rī dkar mo g.yas gnyis pa byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i dge slong dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ dang zhags pa/ srin por tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon po g.yas dang po stag dang bcas pa'i thod pa/ g.yon dang po'i pad+ma dkar po/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/ rlung du ḍoṃ bhi nī nag mo g.yas gnyis na chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ce spyang dang thong gshol 'dzin pa rnams so// lha rnams kyi zur bzhi'i gnas so so'i steng du nyi zla'i bar gyi thig le bzhi po/ waṃ waṃ maṃ maṃ las/ gling bu/ pi waṃ/ mu kuṇ+ḍa/ rdza rnga rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa zla nyi dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo gling bu 'dzin pa/ mer pi waṃ ser mo pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ bden bral du mu kuṇ+ḍa dmar mo rnga mu kuṇ+ḍa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rdza rnga ma ljang mo rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu gnyis po thams cad khro mo'i cha lugs can khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i spyan gsum mnga' zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa'i mtshams su thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// sgo bzhi'i gdan rnams kyi steng du zla nyi'i bar gyi thig le bzhi po/ aṃ baṃ shaṃ saṃ rnams las/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa zla nyi dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor rta gdong nag mo nag dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal rta'i gdong pa ljang gu phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal phag gdong ma dmar mo g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang rdo rje/

g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang dril bu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal khyi'i gdong pa ser po g.yas gnyis lcags sgrog dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang dril bu/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum dang*/ steng zhal seng ge'i gdong pa dmar po g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang dril bu/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar gyis gtum zhing khro la sgeg cing bzhad pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs te sgo bzhir bsrung ba'o// de nas gzhi lam kun la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i nā da de bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa mthong bas chags pa'i sems kyis yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pas yab yum gnyis ka bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas thig le'i gzugs kyi gnas su gyur pa la puk+ka sī gur las/ dri za rab tu zhugs pa ni// lhung de zhu ba rjes dran pas// mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskul// zhes pa'i don/ sogs mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis mthong nas shin tu gdung ba'i sems kyis bcom ldan 'das la bzhengs su gsol bar rdo rje'i glus bskul ba ni/ puk+ka sīs/ snying rje'i thugs kyis rje btsun bzhengs| |puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyob// bdag ni bde chen sbyor 'tshal bas// stong pa'i rang bzhin spang du gsol// zhes dang*/ sha wa rīs/ khyod ni ma bzhugs bdag 'gum pas// dgyes pa rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin btang nas su// ri khrod ma 'bras bsgrub tu gsol// zhes dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa līs/ 'jig rten bde bas mgron gnyer nas// gtso bo ci phyir stong nyid bzhugs// khyod mi bzhugs na phyogs rmongs pas// tsaṇ+ḍa lī bdag gsol ba 'debs// zhes dang*/

ḍoṃ bhi nīs/ bdag ni khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul lta bur khyod bzhengs shig /ḍoṃ bhi bdag gi dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces pa'i zhu ba glus bskul 'di rnams sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa gsum pa rab tu byed pa gsum pa nas byung*/ ces pa'i sgras bskul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran nas thig le dum bu gsum du gyur pa'i 'og dang*/ steng dang*/ nyi zla kha sbyor dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge phrag gnyis kyis mtshan pa dang*/ de'i bar gyi thig le hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ sngon po las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ dang oṃ gyis mtshan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus zla nyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i 'di nas spyi bor oṃ gyi bar shin tu rnal 'byor/ rang nyid 'bras bu'i he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje gur las/ bskul nas 'khor lor 'gre ba/ zhes pa'i don/ zhabs bzhi sa la brdabs pas lha dang lha min zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa 'i bar yab yum gnyis sngar ltar bskyed la/ de nas yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lha mo bcu bdun gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i rang rang gi g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ ces dang*/ go cha bgo ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mig gur las/ mig la gti mug rdo rje sogs| |rdo rje gra po gnas su bkod// ces pa'i don/ rnams su maṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar mo/ rna ba rnams su daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna rnams la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce rnams la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral ba rnams su aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/

snying khar naṃ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i 'di nas dbang gi bar sgrub pa/ spyi bor oṃ las rnal 'byor bzhi'i 'di man la rnal 'byor chen po/ mkha' spyod rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas sa spyod ma dmar mo/ snying khar hūm̐ las sa 'og spyod ma nag mo| thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa spyan gsum mnga' zhing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ gcer mo skra ser po brdzes pa| skra mtshams su thod skam lngas bcings shing rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis zla ba'i steng du ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o// zhes go chas bsrungs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā khe tsā ri bhū tsā ri pa tā la wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi de yan chad la rgyal mchog / gtso bo'i gur las/ ye shes dngos po rab bcug pas// zhes pa'i don/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ brtag gnyis las/ rang gi snying gar sa bon bsam// sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyi gzugs byung nas/ des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa'o// zhes pa'i don/ gi 'od kyis dgyes pa rdo rje ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams su bzhugs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs| oṃ oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a ti ba ti hūm̐ dza dzaḥswā hā/ brtag pa'i rgyal po brgyad pa'i las thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba nas gsungs pa'i spyan drangs pa'i sngags brjod cing*/ dpung pa gnyis su rdo rje bcings pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar gung mtheb kyis se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ gtso bo'i zhal brgyad nas spros pa'i hūm̐ sgras phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

zhes brjod la/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ brtag gnyis las/ ma mo brgyad kyis yang dag mchod par bya'o// zhes pa'i don no// oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥpā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā| oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo kaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ draṃ draṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ draṃ draṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod la/ rdor dril thogs nas/ sems can sgrol byed rnal 'byor bdag la bstod phyag 'tshal// sems can bdag skyes gcig gi dngos la bstod phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rmongs pa gcod la bstod phyag 'tshal// de gnyis gcig tu kun ston de la bdag 'dud do// zhes pa sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa dang po'i de kho na nyid bstan pa'i le'u gsum pa nas 'byung bas bstod la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ brtag gnyis las/ rig ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i 'di yan sgrub pa chen po'o// slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ pañtsa ku la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin shapad 'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga dgyes pa rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i yab yum gyi phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams nas/ brtag gnyis las/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba'i don yin no//

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba 'thor zhing shis pa brjod/ rol mo'i sgra rang 'khrol du sgrog /gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis mchod pa spros/ spyan ma sogs kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ bum pa'i chu las thams cad pas gang ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas bum dbang thob cing*/ brtag gnyis las/ gtor dang blug zhes bya ba ste// des na dbang zhes brjod par bya// zhes pa'i don/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems lce thog tu bab pa myang pas gnas thams cad bde bas khyab ste gsang dbang thob/ slar yang he ru kas bdag med ma las bdag med ma sprul te gnang ba la snyoms par zhugs te/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes nas dbang gsum pa thob pa'i ye shes dbang gi lha he ru kas tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad pa rim pa bzhin du/ rnam pa du ma dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ rnam par 'joms pa dang*/ rnam pa'i mtshan nyid kyis skad cig ma bzhi la dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan skyes bzhi mngon du gyur| rgod pa dang*/ 'phrad pa dang*/ 'khyud pa/ 'khrig pa bzhi rnam par dag pas slob dpon dang mchog dbang gong ma gsum legs par thob/ dbang lha rnams gnyis su med par 'dres nas gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau rī/ puk+ka sī rnams la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī/ sha wa rī/ gling bu ma/ stag gdong ma rnams la rnam snang*/ be tā lī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ pi wang ma/ phag gdong ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ ghasma rī/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ mu kuṇ+ḍa/ khyi gdong ma rnams la 'od dpag med/ rdza rnga ma/ seng gdong ma dag la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/

brtag gnyis las/ phyag rgya rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// 'dis ni rigs ni mtshon par bya// rigs 'chol bsgom pa'i sbyor ba las// dngos grub med cing sgrub pa'ang med// ces pa'i don/ mchan/ ces mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo*// bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni/ thod pa'i nang mchod lag pa g.yas kyis thogs la/ g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis 'bul zhing*/ mgron rnams ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus drangs pas gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur par bsam zhing*/ brtag gnyis las/ bdud rtsi yang ni myong bzhin du// zhes pa'i don/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi khyā ta de wa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇ+ḍi ta bhū mi shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi ma la shrī bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lang dkar ba byang chub seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'dzin pa gu ṇa shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas grub bla ma rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rab 'byams chos rje shī le shwa ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor gtsug lag phreng ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab dang*/ oṃ aṃ nai rāt+mā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yum dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gau rī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs lha mo bcu drug gi sngags mthar yi ge gsum brjod pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong*/ zhing skyong*/ lha/ klu/ srin po/ gnod sbyin/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can gnyug mar gnas pa srid pa gsum du 'khor ba dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha'i rnam par gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thams cad kyang zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshims nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig / ces brjod cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ lnga pa mchod pa don grub kyi yan lag ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs chu gsum nyer spyod lnga rol mo sbyar bas mchod cing*/ slar yang lha mo bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa ni/ gur las/ lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod cing*/ /zhes pa'i don/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag

/de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pa// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// dmar mo gling bu'i sgra 'byin zhing*// ser mo pi wang sgra dang ldan// dmar mo mu kuṇ+ḍa yi rnga// sngon mo rdza rnga thogs rnams kyis// dgyes pa rdo rje tshim par mchod// ces lha mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags rgyas mchod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi sogs rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi he ru ka shī shī shī zhes rjes su chags pas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang gi snying ga'i sa bon la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ drug pa bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag ni/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥ zhes pas dril bu gsil te thogs la/ bstod pa ni/ gur las/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bstod bya'o// zhes pa'i don/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rjes bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal ste| |sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rjer bdag mgur gyur// ces dang*/ yang*/ kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pa// stong nyid snying rje khyod la 'dud// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i mi shes bcad nas su// de nyid ye shes ston mdzad cing*// bdag nyid chos kun la byung ba| |rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan dag /mgon po khyod las byung ba ste// byang chub sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// dkon mchog gsum dang theg pa che// khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi// brtan dang g.yo ba khyod las byung*// 'gro ba'i dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i 'dod pa 'grub don phyir// yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'byung phyir// dpal ldan bde gshegs ye shes gnas// sangs rgyas rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces sam+bu ṭa brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab tu byed pa gsum pa nas gsungs pa ltar bstod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ de dag ni mngon rtogs sbyor ba yan lag drug ldan no// gnyis pa rin chen 'bar ba las/ bsam gtan brtan par mi nus gang*// de ni dag pa rjes su dran// zhes pas/ kun rdzob lha yi dag pa dran pa ni/ brtag gnyis su/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste// zhes sogs dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi dag pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ nges par dngos po thams cad kyi// dag pa de ni brjod du med// ces dang*/ rang rig pa'i dag pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid// dag pa gzhan gyi rnam grol min// yul gyi dngos po dag pa'i phyir// rang gi rig pa'i bde ba mchog /ces sogs gsung pa'i don/ mchan/ lha bsgoms nas dag pa dran pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi lus dbus su// gnas pa'i āḥni sdom pa ste// phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin// sdom pa de ni rab gsal bya// rdo rje'i skye mched khams rnams kyi| |rdo rje bde ba'i phyag rgya che// gsang ba 'di yi snyoms 'jug pa// phyi rol snyoms gnyis spyod ma gsungs// sku gsum 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi'o// lus kyi dbus gnas bshad pa ste// sku gsum yongs su shes gyur pa// bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor brjod// chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*// de ni bde ba chen po ste// skye gnas snying ga mgrin dbus su// sku gsum po ni yang dag gnas// gang la sems can ma lus pa// skye ba nyid du rab tu grags// des na sprul pa'i sku yin te// gang du gnas na sprul pa'i sku// sems kyi rang bzhin chos yin pas// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo yin// ro drug gi ni rang bzhin la// spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs pa ste// chos kun brtag pa nyid kyi phyir// thams cad yod pa'i gzugs nyid kyi// longs spyod 'khor lor gnas pa ste// bde ba chen po spyi bor gnas// e waṃ zhes bya rgyu mthun pa// chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par smin// longs spyod skyes bu'i byed pa ste// rgyu mthun la sogs bye brag gi// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs// las kyi rlung gis spyod pa bzhin// bcom ldan shes rab las la spyod// gang phyir brtan mas sprul pa'i phyir// sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas brtan pa// chos rnams ngag tu byin pas na// thams cad yod smra chos 'khor lo// gang phyir mgrin pa'i nyams myong bas// longs spyod 'khor lo mang po bskor// de phyir bde chen phyir gnas pa// bde chen 'khor lo phal che ba// de ni lus su gsungs pa ste// lto ba gtsug lag khang du gsungs// mngal gnas 'dod chags bral ba yin// sha ma'i dra ba chos gos te// ma ni de bzhin mkhan po ste// spyi bor thal mo 'dud pa yi// 'gro ba'i bya ba bslab nas ni// āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas pa'o// gcer bur skyes shing mgo skra dang*// kha spu breg pa dge slong yin// tshogs 'di dag gi sems can rnams// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// zla ba bcu ni sa bcu ste// sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug nyid// btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du// khu ba'i gzugs kyis yang dag zhugs// de ma rtogs par bde ba med// bde ba spangs na de mi dmigs| |nus med ltos dang bcas pa'i phyir// lha yi sbyor bas bde ba che// de phyir sangs rgyas dngos min zhing*// dngos po med pa nyid kyang min// phyag dang zhabs dang gzugs rnams su// don dam bden pa'i gzugs yod min// des na 'gro kun lhan skyes dga'// lhan skyes zhes bya rnal mar brjod// sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag pas// rang bzhin gyis ni mya ngan 'da'// dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i// 'on kyang tha mal zhan par 'gyur// lha yi gzugs kyi sbyor ba yi// bskyed pa tsam du gnas pa yin// 'di dag rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi// brten pa bla na med pa yin// zhes pa sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa/

bā sa na ti la ka'i brtag pa nas byung ba'i dag pa dran pa dang*/ slar yang*/ bden pa bzhi ni me ri dang dur khrod pad+ma'i ra ba'o// byang chub kyi chos so bdun ni gzhal yas khang ngo*// bden pa bzhi ni sgo ma bzhi'o// dga' ba sogs bzhi ni lha snam gyi lha mo bzhi'o// gzugs ni gau rī'o// sgra ni tsau rī'o// dri ni be tā lī'o// ro ni ghasma rī'o// sha ni puk+ka sī'o// khrag ni sha wa rī'o// khu ba ni tsaṇ+ḍa lī'o// rkang ni ḍoṃ bhi nī'o// shes rab kyi rnam par dag pa ni bdag med ma'o// thabs kyi rnam par dag pa ni/ ye gdod ma'i rig pa dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'o/ / zhes dag pa dran pas dga' ba bzhi'i sems la bslab pa ni/ rang he ru ka gsal ba'i sku'i nang du brtag gnyis las/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba las// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sreg cing*// spyan ma sogs pa yang bsregs te// bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /ces pa'i don/ rtsa gsum gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ las rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus su haṃ mgo dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa'o// mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i rtsa mdud la māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams dang*/ snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi mdud pa la bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ dang*/ lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su a shad rtse mo gyen du phyogs pa rnam par gnas pa la sna bug gi rlung gi sbud pa las/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de lte ba'i gtum mo las me 'bar bas snying kha dang mgrin pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum bcu'i sa bon rtsa mdud du gnas pa bkrol te/ haṃ la reg pas haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab pa gnas rnams su rim gyis bab ste gtum mo'i me la reg la khad cing*/ slar yang dkar cha'i rgyun dang a shad las thon pa'i dmar cha'i rgyun gnyis gyen du 'bar zhing 'dzag pas/ snying khar sleb cing mthar thug snying gi dkar dmar 'dres pas/

rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i lam brgyud de lus thams cad gang bas zag med lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur par dmigs te/ yun ring du bsgom mo// de dag gis skyo na gsum pa a bha yā ka ras/ de spyir bskyed rim de nyid rig /dben par yang dag gnas nas ni// lha'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya// skyo na de'i gsang sngags bzlas// zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ yum gyi thugs kar aṃ la sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa yum gyi zhal nas thon pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon te yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ slar yang yum gyi zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor bar gyur par dmigs nas/ ji skad du/ rtsa ba'i sngags ni sku yi dngos// snying po'i sngags ni gsung gi dngos// nye ba'i snying po thugs yin te// thugs kyi sngags ni snying por brjod// ye shes sa bon zhes bya'i ming*// ye shes sngags su de bshad do// zhes dang*| dpung bzang las/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher mi dbyung ha cang chung ba'ang min// gug kyed klad kor tshig rnams nyams pa med// smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du yeng bzhin min// zhes pa ltar bzla'o// yab kyi rtsa sngags sam phreng ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warda mā ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti nai trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dha ri ṇe/ adh+mā ta krūr tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ḍī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ hāḥphaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags te/ 'di la 'bum phrag bzhi bzla ba ni gzhi bsnyen du grags so//

oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra kartā ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ truṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*// hūm̐/ zhes pa yab kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ āḥnaṃ badz+ra nai rāt+mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi rtsa sngags so// oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// aṃ/ zhes pa yum gyi sa bon no// de ltar rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po/ nye snying*/ sa bon rnams rim gyis lha'i mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar ram/ rdo rje slob dpon du 'os par ni yab kyi snying po kho na 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs pa bzla/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ 'khor so so'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus de nyid la thim par gyur

par dmigs pas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gau rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ mgor oṃ āḥbadz+ra zhes dang*/ mjug tu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā kun la sbyar bas/ tsau rī ye/ be tā lī ye/ ghasma rī ye/ puk+ka sī ye/ sha wa rī ye/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī ye/ ḍoṃ bhi nī ye/ zhes lha mo brgyad dang*/ wāṃ she/ wī ṇi/ mu kuṇ+ḍe/ mṛ taṃ ge/ zhes rol cha ma bzhi dang*/ a shwa mu khe yo gī shwa ri hi hi hi hi hūm̐ dzaḥ rta gdong ma'i'o// daṃṣ+ṭā bā rā ha mu khi trāṃ baṃ trāṃ baṃ hūm̐/ phag gdong ma'i'o// dhā tu saṃ dzī ba ni ma hā yak+ṣi ṇi shwā na rū pi ṇī ma hā pra la ya nir+ṇā de kā ma rū pe trāṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa shwa na mu khi hūm̐ hoḥbaṃ/ khyi gdong ma'i'o// tsan+d+ra sūr+ya hu ta sa ni singha nir+ṇā de singhā bāka tre singhi ni ṭaṃ ṭaṃ hūm̐ hoḥ seng gdong ma'i ste/ lha mo bcu drug po'i sngags kyi thog mthar sngar ltar sbyar la/ yum la khri phrag gsum/ lha mo brgyad la khri phrag re/ rol cha ma bzhi la stong phrag re/ sgo ma bzhi la sum brgya re/ snying po kho na la bzla'o// gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ/ lha mo'i sa bon no// waṃ waṃ maṃ maṃ/ rol cha ma bzhi'i sa bon no// aṃ baṃ shaṃ saṃ/ zhes sgo ma bzhi'i sa bon te sa bon re re yang ci rigs bzla'o// rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin na ye shes dbab pa'i sngags khri phrag gcig bzla zhing*/ bzlas pa rnams tshar ba'i rjes su kha skong la sbyin sreg kyang nges par bya dgos so// rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud brtag pa bdun pa las/ gsang sngags lhag chad gang yin pa// thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis skong*// zhes lhag chad skong byed yin gyi bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dgos zer ba ni min no// mchan/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni| 'dir bskyed rdzogs cha mnyam du ston pa'i don du na/ bskyed rdzogs gang yang re re gal che bar mi ston pa gnyis med rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin te/

kha cig gis ni dgyes pa rdo rje ma rgyud du bzhed pa 'dug kyang de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ brtag gnyis las| thabs dang shes rab dag gi rgyud// de ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon// zhes thabs shes cha mnyam du bstan pa'i phyir ro// 'dir rdzogs rim thun bsdu ba phyogs gcig tu bya ba ni man ngag gi zab gnad de 'di ltar ro// rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ gur las/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste// gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba nyid// gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste// bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba// lnga pa rtag tu snang na ste// sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid// ces dang*/ dril bu pas/ sa bon 'od kyi shes rab bdag po dang*// 'khor lo pa dang khang pa brtsegs pa rnams// snang bar byas te 'od gur rim bzhin bsdu// gzhal yas khang sgo ma bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi rol cha ma bzhi| rol cha ma bzhi lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad yab kyi zhal brgyad la bsdu/ slar yang yum yab la thim/ yab thugs ka'i rdo rje la/ rdo rje hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yig de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo bo nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du gnas par gyur/ thog ma tha ma dbus med cing*// 'khor min mya ngan 'das pa min// gzhan min bdag min ma yin pa// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen yin// zhes dar cig mtshan ma hūm̐ nyi zla dang bcas pa la sems gtad de bsgom pa ni mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ slar yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gnyis po hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du bsdus nas nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs pa las chos thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i de kho na nyid la gnas par gyur/ /ji skad du/ rnam par rtog pa kun bral bas| |bsam brjod yul las shin tu 'das// mkha' bzhin dri med kun 'byung ba// rtags bral zab mo nyid ces bya// phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs 'chang ba// sgyu ma 'ja' tshon lta bu ru// rang ngam gzhan gyi rgyud sbyor ro// yang dag gsal ba zhes bya'o| |zhes pa'i don phyag rgya chen po la dgongs so// zhes mi skyo'i bar du mnyam par 'jog pa ni mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim mo//

slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par mos te skad cig ma la'o// gsum pa thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la brgyad/ rdzus skyes sbyong byed dang mtshungs so// sdom 'byung las| myos byed gtor ma med pa 'gas// myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// des na sngon gyi sangs rgyas ches// gtor ma'i bsngags pa rab tu gsungs// zhes pa/ gtor ma btang ba/ smon lam gdab pa/ kha zas/ rjes chags/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/ khrus/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang brgyad do// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa la'o// dang po ni/ mchod pa'i gtor mar bdud rtsis bran te/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas| rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra i maṃ ba ling+ta gṛh+ṇagṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes gsum brjod la/ pad kor bya zhing thod pa kha dbye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum gyi mthar se gol dang*/ de bzhin du/ i maṃ ba liṃ man chad kun la sbyar te/ oṃ āḥnai rāt+mā ye i maṃ= yum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ye i maṃ sogs sbyar ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i dus bzhin gyi lha mo brgyad dang*/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she i maṃ sogs rol cha ma bzhi dang*/ oṃ a shwa mu khi sogs kyi mthar/ i maṃ sbyar bas sgo ma bzhi la 'bul zhing*/ sngags rnams re re nas lan gsum gsum brjod pa'i mthar se gol gtogs shing*/ sngags ni bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'dir rigs bsgre bar bya zhing*/ rtsa sngags nye snying sa bon rnams ni 'dir mi dgos shing snying po rnams kyis chog go// de nas oṃ dzaḥhūm̐

la sogs pa'i sngags kyi mthar sngar ltar chu gsum nyer spyod lnga rol mo bcas pas mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril thogs te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni de nyid thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun bsgrubs pa// snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /ces bstod/ skabs 'dir rang gi yi dam chos skyong gzhan yod na gtor 'bul gyi rim pa rnams gtor ma so sor rgyas par bshams la bya'o// mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i gtor 'bul rgyas pa re skabs 'dir med du mi rung ngo*// gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ gtor chung gi mdun du chu gsum nyer spyod dang bcas pa bshams la/ gtor chung la nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ kun sbyor las/ rang 'dod las la sbyin bya ba// khyad par du yang gtor ma sbyin| |zhes dang*/ mi thub zla bas/ bar chad thams cad nyer zhi phyir// gtor ma rgyun du sbyin par bya// zhes pa'i don no// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong brgyad nyi zla la sogs pa'i lha dang*/ gzhan yang klu brgyad rgyal chen la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas skad cig gis spyan drangs/ mdun du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa steng 'og bar gsum du yod pa'i gdan so so la 'khod par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs bzhis dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ mnyes par byas te/ dril bu 'khrol zhing*/ oṃ/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*| |ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo zhing dang ni// khyad par du ni khang stong dang*// sems can smod dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chu la gnas// nag po drag po drag chen po// lhas byin mnyam du bsten pa dang*// nag po gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*// rga las 'das dang log 'dren dang*// dga' byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang*// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag mo sbom dang rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// sum cu'i dbang po 'phrog byed ma// mar me 'jigs byed rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen ma// thod phreng can dang 'jigs byed ma// sbrul can ral gri dgra sta can// rdo rje de ni gzhu can ma// de nyid chen mo'i mkha' 'gro lnga// las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma// sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad kun las 'dir spyon cig

/ ces sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa dgu pa'i rab tu byed pa gnyis pa nas gsungs so// zhes skad cig gis bkug ste so sor 'khod pa'i steng du gnas pa rnams oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ bar du gnas pa rnams hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ 'og tu gnas pa rnams āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur/ ces dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du chu gnyis rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gsol bas tshim par gyur/ dril bu yun du gsil bas/ oṃ in+da dza ma dza la dzak+kha/ bhu da ba h+ni bā u rak+kha/ tsan+da su+udz+dza mā da ba p+pa ta la pā tā le aṭaṭha sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba ling bhuñdza dzi gha phul+la dhū pa maṃ sa piṃ gha/ am+bha sap+pa kadz+dza sarba sā da khaṇati khu ṇi phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis phul zhing phrin las bcol te/ zo zo za bar gyis shig gnod sbyin dang*// zhes pa nas/ rnam dag rig dang lhan cig bdag mdzad gsol| | zhes pa'i bar mgron sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar phrin las bcol nas gtor ma gtsang sar phul la/ rdo rje thogs pa'i g.yas kyis pad kor bya zhing g.yon gyis dril bu gsil bas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra rā dzap+su ra ya sa ma thu/ lo tsa na da sha ye/ ak+ṣa ra bha nu swā hā/ sum+bi la sna pa ye/ bha wā ba bha sbe murta ye/ ma dza bi dza ni ye/ bhañdza bi ak+ṣa rū pa bu/ a she sha tsi na tā ye/ dan+ta liṅga na dzo bu/ sa l+ling ging tsa ya/ sa ba su na da ma ya/ daṃ bhā ya ā da ya suṃ pa bi yaṃ/ mi kha pi pa bi ya ye/ su ha saṃ ra ra bi mo hi ya/

mo kha bi ka dza ya ye/ sa ba su na sa ha be/ dzo gi nī martā ya/ bi ni tsa ya ye/ badz+ra bi dza ye ni/ bu tat+tu u la khi ye/ sarba ma he ba hu ba hi/ ru sup+ta bi ga tsi ya ye/ badz+ra su ri ya ka dza ru/ dam+ba mo hi ya ye/ na ma ha su sa ru da mu/ dzo gi nī mu khi ya ye/ zhes sam+bu ṭa brtag pa dgu pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba zhes bya ba nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i glu blangs so// de nas/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gis 'thor 'thung phul la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po rnams rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ mgron rnams rang rang gi cha lugs su gyur nas rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/ gnyis pa smon lam ni/ mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho cher lhung ba// rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// ces gsungs pa'i don no// mchan/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'i thal mo snying khar bzhag ste/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor mchog /bsgoms dang nye bar bzlas pa dang*// mchod sogs las byung 'di dag dges// bsod nams mthu las byung ba yi// dge ba gang thob 'di dag gis// sangs rgyas kun gyi nor thams cad// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ni// 'gro ba lnga yis thob par shog /byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med dgyes pa rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje ldan// lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog / sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig

/sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad 'gyur ba'i// lam de nyid la zhugs par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*| |ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab bo// gsum pa kha zas ni/ kha zas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud bsdus pa rang gi g.yon du bzhag pa yi dam dang*/ g.yas su bzhag pa chos skyong du phul nas/ rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte bar raṃ las a bhi bas/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// chu gnas su ni raṃ las kyang*// 'bar ba'i khung bu 'od 'bar bsam// de nas paṃ las chu skyes brgyad// de ru lha yi dkyil 'khor bsam// kha ni hom khung rab bsam ste// lag gnyis hūm̐ las rdo rje yi// gzar bu gnyis su yang dag bsgom// zhes dang*/ yang ye shes zhabs kyis/ gang zhig tsha ba'i tshe na yang*// bsgoms pa'i ngo bo ji lta ba'i// lus ni lha yi dkyil 'khor ste// zas ni bdud rtsir byin brlabs te// zos pas dbyer med tshim par bsam// zhes gnyis po gang bde ltar bya/ mchan/ me'i dkyil 'khor du bsam zhing*/ kha hom khung du mos la/ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las byung pa'i dgang blugs kyis zas bdud rtsir gyur pa blangs te phul bas rtsa khams lha tshogs mchod par dmigs la/ longs spyod pa'i lhag ma bdud rtsis bran la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// bzhi pa rjes su ji skad du/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bud med gzugs dang mdangs bzang ba// lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la// byin gyis brlabs te gnas gsum du// dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// chags pa ni/ dngos sam yid las byung ba'i rig ma la man ngag ltar bya'o// lnga pa nyal ba'i tshe/ ye shes zhabs kyis/ ji ltar nyal ba'i tshe na yang*// rdo rje 'dzin chen ting 'dzin gyi// chags chen rjes su chags byas te// ye shes sems dpa'i lus zhugs la// chos kun sems su gyur pas na// zhes so// mchan/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snod bcud rang la bsdu/ rang yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ de yang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar rim gyis bsdus nas nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du nyal lo// drug pa ldang ba'i tshe/

ye shes zhabs kyis/ de las ldang ba'i tshe na yang*// tshad med bzhi yis bskul ba yis// sngon gyi smon lam rjes dran nas// sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyor ba yis| |ting 'dzin rim pas ldang bar bya// zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bas/ rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// bdun pa khrus ni/ chu dbang skabs ltar yig brgya brjod cing khrus bya'o// brgyad pa spyod lam ni| brtag gnyis las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa 'am// yang na he ru ka dpal brtsam// gzhan pa'i sems ni skad cig kyang*// dngos grub 'dod pas mi gnas so// zhes dang*/ ye shes zhabs kyis/ spyod lam kun tu lha nyid kyi// ting nge 'dzin las nyams mi bya// zhes dang*/ mkha' spyod pas/ shrī he ru ka'i go 'phang gnas// yan lag gi ni spyod pa dang*// tshig gi rab 'byams ji snyed pa// de snyed phyag rgya gsang sngags yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// mchan/ snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang lha'i ngo bor mos/ bag med pa'i spyod lam phran bu tsam yang yun ring du mi byed/ de ltar dus rtag tu thun bzhi drug tu nyams su blang na tshe 'di la dgyes pa rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub par 'gyur pa ni gsang sngags kyi sde snod las legs par gsungs so// 'di dag zhib tu rtogs par 'dod na 'grel byed gzhan rnams su rtogs par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs// kha sbyor rgyud kyi rim pa ji lta bar// yan lag drug gi go rim gyis brgyan cing*// sbyor dngos mjug gi cho gas kha bskangs pa// rnam dpyod 'di las sgrub thabs gzhan mchis sam// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras la sogs pa// mngal nges brjod bla ma las/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yi// bsgoms pa rnams kyis yongs su rtogs/ zhes dang*/ mchan/ sgong sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste// sgra dang sgra min spang ba'o// zhes dang*/

drod gsher las skyes sbyong byed ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel par/ zla ba sa bon tsam las skye ba ni// skyes gnas drod gsher sbyong byed do// zhes gsungs so| |mchan/ rdzus dril bu pas/ sems can rdzus te skyes pa bzhin// sa bon med par rnam par bsgom// zhes so// mchan/ skyes sbyong thabs so so rnams// 'byed pa'i blo gros mig dang bral na yang*// rang bzo bsres lhad bdud kyi las byed pa'i// sgrub thabs mchis pa kun dang 'di mi mnyam// de brtsams pa las byung ba yi// dge ba dri med mchis pa'i mthus// dgyes pa rdo rje myur 'grub nas// lha mo'i 'khor lor cis mi rol// zhes kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba 'di/ gtso bo sam+bu ṭa nyid kyi rgyud sor bzhag cing skabs su babs pa kha shas rgya gzhung khungs thub mang po nas kha bskangs te mngal skyes sbyong byed gtso bor byas pa 'di'ang*/ dbur stod 'bri gung du skyes pa'i dge slong sgra tshad mdo so so'i nang don rig pa smra ba/ gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su len pa'i blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'am/ ming gzhan chos kyi grags pa zhes bgyi bas/ zla kun dga' tshal gyi chos grwa'i dbus dpal rnam gnon tshul khrims kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i gzim chung bde ba can du sbyar ba'o// blo dman the tshom bral ba yi// sngags gzhung rgya mtsho'i dka' gnad rnams// mchan bus legs par bkral ba 'di// chos kyi grags pa kho bos sbyar// 'di la rtog dpyad mdzad pas ni// rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa'i// nges don snying po cis mi rtogs// de bas dal 'byor don yod mdzod// //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ//
